item.description: The dollar is heading for its best week in a month as investors return to the traditional haven amid heightened geopolitical tensions.

item.description: Traders are preparing for a spike in borrowing from Persian Gulf nations as the region’s oil exporters seek financing to build costly bypasses around the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: BofA’s Raedler Says Investors Are Ignoring Stock-Market Risks
item.description: Stock markets are pricing in a scenario where everything goes right, leaving investors uncompensated for mounting risks, according to Sebastian Raedler, head of European equity strategy at Bank of America Corp.

item.title: UK Food Prices to Peak Lower Than Thought, BOE Survey Finds

item.description: The European Central Bank started the onboarding process for non-euro area central banks to allow them to tap euro liquidity later this year.

item.description: Victoria Plc reported a wider annual loss as the troubled British carpetmaker counted the cost of its recent debt refinancing.

item.description: Zara billionaire Amancio Ortega bought a business center in Paris from Invesco Ltd., in what is his biggest transaction in Europe.

item.title: Odd Lots: How Franchising Led to the Gig Economy (Podcast)

This model allowed independent operators to license trademarks from a business like McDonald’s or Dunkin Donuts, and it soon spread across the country, with huge consequences for how Americans are employed.
